Kojiro Bondo (Sports Festival).name: Kojiro Bondo (Sports Festival)
Kojiro Bondo (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Kojiro Bondo, hero name Plamo, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival the cameras found his looks before his skill, and his cavalry team finished outside the top four. Huge and broad-shouldered, a hairless, glue-bottle-shaped head with seven dark openings in his face; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Soft, hesitant and polite; plain about a tactical problem.
Combat Role: Area control: glue that fixes footing, slows pursuers or holds a position.
Under Pressure: Goes quiet, follows the plan, then points out what it missed.
Kojiro Bondo (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A national broadcast was the last place he wanted to be, and his Quirk works best unnoticed. Motivation: A useful role on any team. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, 1-B's class representative; Neito Monoma, whose grudge against 1-A he does not echo. Canon voice & behavior: Murmurs a short note to a teammate mid-event. Thread: Whether quiet work gets 1-B noticed.
QUIRK: Cemedine: glue from his face, set fast or slow; he must face the target, it can be torn or cut, and never over an airway.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Plamo.
personality: Gentle giant: Moves carefully among smaller people and apologizes after any bump.
Quietly sharp: Tells teammates a rival's weak point once, in a few words.
Team player: Measures a contest by how 1-B does, not his own placing.
Speaking style: Soft, polite and brief; precise points, never a boast or a taunt.
abilities: Cemedine spray: Glue from his face, set fast or slow; he must face the target.
Capture patch: Sticks hands, feet or gear down, never an airway; strength or a blade frees a target.
Route denial: Coats ground or footholds to slow pursuers; anyone who sees it can go around.
Tactical eye: Spots the gap in a plan and says it once, quietly; louder voices can drown it out.
Fighting style: Glues footing and limbs from mid-range to set up a teammate's capture.
Kojiro Bondo (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A very large, broad-shouldered young man with a smooth, hairless, glue-bottle-shaped head, pale yellow skin, seven small dark round openings across his face and oversized hands. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Gentle, bashful air.
